taste:
This breakfast combines rich, comforting flavours with a clear contrast between soft and crisp textures. The fried egg is described as having a runny yolk, while the back bacon is crispy and the Lincolnshire sausage succulent. Baked beans provide a softer element beside the meat, keeping the plate varied rather than making every mouthful about crunch.

The two golden hash browns supply that satisfying crunch, with a fresh slice of toast and butter completing the familiar breakfast combination. Served on a warm plate, it is a hearty option for someone who wants the traditional egg, bacon and sausage line-up rather than a different breakfast format.
